;===========================COOP=============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================
«S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Shadow of COOP» is an addon for the multiplayer modification «X-Ray Multiplayer Extension» that lets you play through the reworked Shadow Of Chernobyl storyline in co-op, designed for 2 to 4 players. \n-Inventory is saved before moving to the next location. \n-To pick a map manually, press F5 and vote for the map where you left off.
